goal.objective: Activate and continuously advance the stable non-authorizing StegGate rendezvous through independently admitted StegVerse task control. Heartbeat is reference-only and noncausal. StegVerse is primary; third-party transport is FALLBACK_ONLY and unavailable provider state may never block progress.
success_predicates: The worker is atomically claimed/fenced by separate admitted StegVerse task control.
Heartbeat observation is reference-only and grants no execution authority.
Any unavailable third-party credential, capability, quota, outage, or deployment path returns ACTIVE/THIRD_PARTY_WORKAROUND_REQUIRED rather than BLOCKED.
At least one admitted StegVerse-owned/federated path is selected and advanced before optional third-party fallback.
Only the canonical Site rendezvous source blob is deployed.
The selected stable route passes readiness, canonical health, and exact ALLOW/DENY/REVIEW/FAIL_CLOSED self-test.
No credential value is persisted in repository state or receipts.
failure_predicates: A third-party dependency is represented as BLOCKED.
The worker repeatedly rechecks a provider condition without selecting a workaround.
Heartbeat availability is treated as deployment authority.
Mutable/unverified Site worker source is deployed.
Deployment success is treated as live acceptance without probes.
Credential values are written to repository state or receipts.

task.derivation_reason: Unresolved rendezvous work is machine-owned under separate admitted task control. Heartbeat is a noncausal reference only. Cloudflare is an optional FALLBACK_ONLY path; external provider state is never an unresolved task dependency.

activation.recheck_trigger: each admitted StegVerse task-control execution opportunity while task remains unfinished; third-party repeats must advance workaround selection rather than repeat blocker observation

completion.next_authorized_action: On the next admitted StegVerse task-control opportunity, select a StegVerse-owned/federated rendezvous path first. Use Cloudflare only when immediately usable as explicit FALLBACK_ONLY under TV/TVC; otherwise advance an admitted non-provider-dependent path and prove stable live acceptance.
terminal_when: Worker returns COMPLETED with transition LIVE_ACCEPTANCE_PASS
Stable readiness and health are externally observable
Self-test proves ALLOW, DENY, REVIEW, and FAIL_CLOSED
Completion evidence contains no credential values
No third-party service is required for continued StegVerse progress

cosv.notation: L R U I V G O C M T B E A P
